facts.text: Jon mentions that dance is his stress-buster since childhood.

evidence.quote: It's been my stress-buster since childhood!

facts.text: Jon states that dancing helps him de-stress and is where he feels most alive.

evidence.quote: Dancing helps me de-stress. It's where I'm most alive.

facts.text: Jon expresses that he cannot imagine life without dance, comparing it to air.

evidence.quote: I can't picture life without it. It's like air.

facts.text: Jon mentions that he started his own dance studio after losing his job.

evidence.quote: Losing my job gave me the push to finally start my dream business: my own dance studio!
